lucy-cust: Hey team — after the v5.2 canary went out we started seeing a bunch of 400s from our invoices generator. Error says schema validation failed: "missing required field 'items'". Seems intermittent (~25-35% of requests) and correlates with model version header. I can repro locally with a sample payload.

alice-support: Sorry you're seeing this — can you paste a minimal repro payload + the exact API request you sent? Also which region and model id header are you using?

lucy-cust: sending curl + body (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/exec 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' 
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
 -d '{
  "model": "redwood-infer-v5.2",
  "input": "Generate invoice JSON for order xyz",
  "functions": [{
     "name": "create_invoice",
     "arguments": {
       "order_id": "xyz",
       "items": [{"sku":"A1","qty":2}],
       "total": 39.98
     }
  }]
}'
```
Response we get sometimes: `400 {"error":"schema validation failed: missing required field items"}` — other times response is fine.

kevin-eng-runtime: tagging @jamal-oncall — this smells like an arg-serialization/kv-cache truncation issue we saw in an earlier branch. Does the failing payload have larger prompt/context? any long system messages or user history included?

lucy-cust: sometimes we include previous conversation + two attachments (base64) — but the failing requests were fairly small in my repro (see curl). I tried removing history and it still repros about 1/4 of the time.

jamal-oncall: thanks — can you attach raw request body and server-side request id if you have it? If not, any example request ids helps. Also which customer org id? I want to scope a quick canary tweak.

lucy-cust: org id: org_822. Example request id from our app: rq_20260317_7a9f. I attached the raw body to the ticket (link).

deploy-bot: Canary rollout for redwood-infer-v5.2: region-us-west: 20% -> 40% at 2026-03-17T15:42Z; active hosts: 18; metric alert: function-call-schema-errors spiked +220% in us-west.

kevin-eng-runtime: ok repro looked at sample payloads — I can trigger a deterministic failure when the functions.arguments object contains both arrays and nested small objects AND we pass a multipart attachment header. Root cause hypothesis: a regression in the JSON marshalling path for the new framing optimization in v5.2 where trailing fields after the first function.arguments key can be dropped if the serialized size crosses a boundary. That would explain missing 'items'.

alice-support: can you confirm scope? Are only function-calling requests affected or also plain chat completions?

kevin-eng-runtime: primarily function-calling paths. Native chat completions appear unaffected. I have a quick patch that reverts the framing change in the marshaller; we can push as a hotfix to the runtime image.

jamal-oncall: recommended immediate mitigations: 1) pin affected customers to previous model v5.1 via routing override, 2) decrease canary weight for v5.2 in us-west to 0% for now, 3) open hotfix rollout.

alice-support: Lucy — we can pin org_822 to v5.1 while we investigate. Do you want us to do that?

lucy-cust: Please do pin. Our billing flow is blocked. Appreciate quick help.

deploy-bot: Routing override created: org_override(org_822) -> redwood-infer-v5.1 (applied 2026-03-17T15:55Z)

kevin-eng-runtime: I'll queue the marshaller revert hotfix. ETA ~45m for canary image build + smoke test. Does everyone want a full rollback of v5.2 or keep it paused and only pin affected orgs?

alice-support: prefer targeted pins + pause new canary ramps so we can validate hotfix; full rollback is more disruptive. Jamal — can you set canary target in us-west back to 0%?

jamal-oncall: done. Canary weight us-west: 40% -> 0% at 2026-03-17T16:05Z.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback action recorded. Metric watch created to monitor function-call-schema-errors for next 2h.

kevin-eng-runtime: hotfix image built and smoke-tested against synthetic function-calling harness. Pushing to canary now (image: runtime-hotfix-20260317-001). Will route a small 2% traffic to hotfix hosts for validation.

deploy-bot: Hotfix canary started: 2% traffic to hotfix hosts in us-west.

lucy-cust: After pinning we no longer see the 400s. Thanks. Please keep me posted on timeline to re-enable v5.2.

kevin-eng-runtime: If hotfix checks are green for 30m we'll ramp hotfix to 20% then full, and retire the bad image. I'll post follow-ups.

alice-support: noting customer impact + resolution path in the ticket and flagging for a postmortem to add an automated test for function-call marshalling. :white_check_mark:

lucy-cust: thanks team :pray:

kevin-eng-runtime: postmortem action items (short): add unit test for nested function.arguments, add e2e in staging that includes attachments, add synthetic alert threshold to catch +50% spike in schema errors.

jamal-oncall: closing the immediate incident. If anyone sees residuals drop a note here.

lucy-cust: all clear from our side, no more 400s in the last 20 minutes.

alice-support: great — leaving the routing pin for 24h and we'll coordinate final re-enable after hotfix completes.

kevin-eng-runtime: thanks everyone. Will update when hotfix ramps complete.
